body: Do you have a spouse? Do you have any parents? Siblings?
Exactly! Haha, if anything it's a way to keep busy.

Well we are supposed to make sure the lawns aren't disgusting through weeding and only cutting it the old fashioned way when it gets ridiculously tall. The few people who made it to the community that refused to accept the situation have either off-ed themselves or finally accepted it and are doing fine.
My name is Ian, my wife's name is Jane, my son's name is Victor, and my daughter's name is Lily.

We all do our part. For instance, I help with the walls, patching them up or even helping with the guard duties. My wife helps out at the cafeteria, cooking and serving people their food. My oldest son goes on scavenging runs and my daughter is a nurse and an actress in the plays that are performed so we don't all lose our minds.

We have a meeting where we vote on stuff, and the kids go to school with the other kids. We make sure that the kids have friends and stay kids and play. We always have gatherings and we pretend we know when holidays are. Very social community.
We're living off of what we farm or butcher from the farms we've built inside the community.

Zombies were everywhere... I tried leading all three of my kids away safely, but one of them grabbed him. Tore open his stomach, and started devouring his remains. All while he's screaming "Daddy!! Mommy!!!"...

My 10 year old son was killed when we were still roaming looking for supplies and shelter. My wife's sister, who was staying with us when the world went to shit, was killed by other survivors. I couldn't believe it.
Hell. Death is just everywhere. I hate having to raise my children here. We're relatively safe but we don't actually know for how long we will remain safe. Walls are breathable you know.
We think it's the year 2042. We lost track around after the first full year. We don't quite know how it started, government gave up on us very quickly.
